evidence.excerpt: Prefers industry collaborations that involve access to genuine production data rather than model-system recreations; has limited availability for new projects in the first half of 2025 due to departmental accreditation obligations. Is particularly interested in connecting with NTP companies whose core product involves a fermentation step, even if microbiology is not their primary expertise.
